title: Hassler Roma vs Casa Monti: Grand Hotel or Boutique Fun? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Hotel Hassler Roma vs Casa Monti, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: grand hotel or hip boutique, the Spanish Steps or Monti, rooms, dining, spa, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A Hotel Hassler Roma bedroom framed by an arched doorway, with a studded headboard and crystal lamps
Casa Monti’s downstairs restaurant, with striped banquettes, wicker chairs and a marble-fronted bar

sub: A very traditional grand hotel, or a hip boutique hotel that is its opposite. One is at the top of the Spanish Steps; the other is in Monti among real Roman trattorias. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you love classic, traditional luxury
choose.lead: A very nice, very traditional hotel right at the top of the Spanish Steps, with a Michelin-starred restaurant on the roof. You can’t get much more iconic.
choose.alt: The Spanish Steps at sunrise, with Hotel Hassler Roma at the top

choose.h3: If you want hip, young and fun
choose.lead: So cute. A boutique hotel from the team behind Le Fantaisie in Paris, with super cool patterns, a rooftop restaurant and a spa couples can have to themselves.
choose.alt: A Casa Monti terrace with patterned chairs and climbing jasmine over the tiled rooftops of Monti

band.h2: Do you want Rome’s grand-hotel tradition, or the opposite?
paras: The Hassler is a very traditional hotel, and that’s the appeal. You get the top of the Spanish Steps and a Michelin-starred dinner on the roof.
Casa Monti is the hotel I send people to when the Hassler feels too traditional. It is hip, young and fun, and on a Sunday the trattorias around it are full of Romans having lunch.
If grand-hotel style is part of the dream, pick the Hassler. If you are a younger couple who wants something fun and a real neighborhood, pick Casa Monti.

guide.alt: A yellow vintage Fiat 500 with the Casa Monti logo outside the hotel’s arched entrance on Via Panisperna
paras: The Hassler is right above the Spanish Steps, about as central as Rome gets. It also means a busy area: you step out the door and you are in the crowds at the Steps.
Casa Monti is in Monti, and the neighborhood is the real thing. There are authentic Roman trattorias all around, and when I visited on a Sunday, real Romans were having lunch at them.

guide.alt: A Hotel Hassler Roma bedroom with a fabric-covered canopy bed, damask walls and a gilded frame
paras: The Hassler’s rooms are very traditional, with canopy beds and damask walls, and some bathrooms look over the rooftops to St. Peter’s.
Casa Monti is from the same company as Le Fantaisie in Paris, and it shows: super cool patterns, pattern on pattern, and curtains that hide the TV.

guide.alt: A freestanding tub in a black marble Hotel Hassler Roma bathroom, with windows over the rooftops to St. Peter’s
paras: The dining is a highlight at the Hassler: a Michelin-starred restaurant on the roof with the rooftops of Rome laid out below you, and a beautiful restaurant in the courtyard.
Casa Monti has a beautiful rooftop restaurant and a lively restaurant downstairs, and the trattorias outside the door.

guide.alt: The Casa Monti spa pool, raised on golden marble steps between two white amphorae
paras: At Casa Monti, couples can book the spa just for the two of them. I arrange it before you arrive.
The Hassler’s large new wellness and gym area opens in 2027. Until then, if a spa matters, I point people to the Bulgari or the Corinthia.

faq.q: Which is better, the Hassler or Casa Monti?
faq.a: They suit opposite travelers. The Hassler is for classic, traditional luxury at the top of the Spanish Steps. Casa Monti is for younger couples who want something hip, young and fun.

faq.q: Which is better for a honeymoon?
faq.a: For younger honeymooners, Casa Monti, and book the private spa. The Hassler suits travelers who love classic luxury; for a classic Rome stay as a couple, my top pick is the Eden.
Casa Monti, which couples can book privately. The Hassler’s new wellness and gym area opens in 2027.
The Hassler has a Michelin-starred restaurant on the roof. Casa Monti has two restaurants of its own and real Roman trattorias all around.

faq.q: I want something in between. What else?
faq.a: For quiet, warm, classic luxury above the Steps, the Eden, my top pick in Rome. For a palazzo by the Pantheon with real-Rome energy, La Minerva.
